summary.text: One of the forty-four suitors from Zacynthus in Apollodorus' catalogue — a mortal namesake only, wholly distinct from the daimones of Greek religion.

story.text: Apollodorus names Daemon among the wooers assigned to Zacynthus, listed after Nisas and before Archestratus in Epitome 7.29 — a man who bears the common noun for a divine spirit as a personal name and nothing more.
